issues.issue: Must the Attorney General apply to the Federal Court under s. 38.04(2) of the Canada Evidence Act?
issues.applicant_position: AG must bring a s. 38.04(2) application: his letter limited disclosure, and the documents referred to are in his possession.
issues.respondent_position: AG unconditionally authorized disclosure of all information in the notice, so no s. 38.04(2) application is needed.
issues.result_quote: That compels the conclusion that there is no foundation for an application under subsection 38.04(2)

issues.issue: Is there a factual basis for a declaration that Lopez may give any evidence in his defence if the AG does not apply?
issues.applicant_position: If the AG does not apply under s. 38.04(2), he may give any evidence in his own defence at the hearing.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents moved to strike the application; no factual foundation yet exists for this remedy.
issues.result_quote: Until he does so, the application discloses no factual foundation for the third remedy listed above.

issues.issue: Is there a factual basis for a declaration that certain Canada Evidence Act provisions are unconstitutional?
issues.applicant_position: Certain provisions of the Canada Evidence Act are unconstitutional.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents moved to strike; no factual foundation yet exists for a constitutional challenge.
issues.result_quote: Similarly, until the proper procedure is played out, there is no factual foundation for a constitutional challenge.
